milestones.name: Acquire Dream Nail
milestones.note: Required to fight Elder Hu's spirit at his memorial

milestones.name: Defeat Elder Hu
milestones.note: Elder Hu's spirit shatters into 100 Essence collected by the Dream Nail

milestones.name: Collect 100 Essence from Elder Hu
milestones.note: Rewarded after defeating Elder Hu's spirit

milestones.name: Obtain Love Key
milestones.note: Held by a large dead Husk Dandy in Queen's Gardens; can be Dream Nailed for dialogue

milestones.name: Obtain Mask Shard
milestones.note: Located in Fungal Wastes; requires Mantis Claw

zones.name: Fungal Wastes
zones.fingerprintHint: Dark murky hallways, curved lattice pattern backgrounds, fungi-themed environment; contains Mantis Village sub-area

zones.name: Mantis Village
zones.note: Sub-area of Fungal Wastes; site of Elder Hu's death at the hands of the Mantis Lords and Tribe

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.note: Elder Hu's memorial is located above the gates to the City of Tears

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.note: Location of the Love Key held by a large dead Husk Dandy

abilities.name: Dream Nail
abilities.grants: Ability to fight dream spirits and collect Essence; can also be used on certain corpses for dialogue
abilities.note: Required to initiate Elder Hu boss fight and collect Essence

abilities.name: Shade Cloak
abilities.note: Highly recommended (not required) for dodging Elder Hu's Ring Slam attack; enables Shade Cloak dodge strategy

abilities.name: Mantis Claw
abilities.note: Required to reach the Mask Shard in Fungal Wastes

abilities.name: Howling Wraiths
abilities.note: Spell usable in the Elder Hu spell build strategy

abilities.name: Abyss Shriek
abilities.note: Upgraded spell usable in the Elder Hu spell build strategy; alternative to Howling Wraiths

abilities.name: Shaman Stone
abilities.note: Charm recommended for spell build against Elder Hu

abilities.name: Spell Twister
abilities.note: Charm recommended for spell build against Elder Hu

abilities.name: Soul Catcher
abilities.note: Charm recommended for spell build against Elder Hu

abilities.name: Soul Eater
abilities.note: Charm recommended for spell build against Elder Hu

bosses.name: Elder Hu
bosses.note: Dream boss fought at his memorial above the gates to the City of Tears; requires Dream Nail to initiate. Has Ring Slam, Ring Curtain, and Teleport attacks. Drops 100 Essence on defeat.

bosses.name: Mantis Lords
bosses.note: Killed Elder Hu after he attacked them in his Infected madness; mentioned as context, not a fight in this segment
